name: UF-style-dosrpg
note: dosrpg — MS-DOS CRPG portrait: DOS VGA LoRA, 144x144 in its own 256 colors. — unfake grid snap (true model grid, reduced to the canvas), despeckle 1. Twin of FACTORY/style-dosrpg.  (sample: seed 1280)

form.subject: an (old bearded wizard:1.3), (pointed hat:1.1), a (glowing staff:1.2)
form.negative: (3d render, realistic, photograph:1.3), (blurry:1.2), smooth gradient, (antialiased:1.1), jpeg artifacts, (text, watermark, signature:1.3), (full body:1.2), cropped head, (multiple faces:1.2)
